title: 05P - Incident Management
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

Your role As an Incident Manager, you will lead the end-to-end management of incidents that impact customer services, with a strong focus on service restoration, coordination, and clear communication. This role is central to maintaining customer trust during service disruptions by driving structured incident response, orchestrating cross functional teams, and ensuring incidents are resolved efficiently and consistently. You will balance real-time incident leadership with continuous improvement of incident management practices and outcomes. What you will do •Lead the management of incidents from identification through resolution, ensuring timely service restoration •Orchestrate incident bridges and coordinate multiple technical teams and service partners during active incidents •Own communication to customers and internal stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle using defined communication plans •Ensure incident priorities, impacts, and escalations are assessed accurately and consistently •Drive post incident reviews, documenting root causes, actions taken, and improvement opportunities •Partner with Problem Management to trigger deeper root cause analysis when required •Monitor incident trends and metrics to identify recurring issues and opportunities for service improvement •Maintain compliance with IT Service Management (ITSM) processes and continuously improve incident management execution  

**Who You Are**

Required skills and experience •Experience working within ITSM frameworks and incident management processes •Hands on experience with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow or equivalent platforms •Ability to lead and coordinate cross functional technical teams during high impact incidents •Experience managing customer communications during service disruptions •Familiarity with formal troubleshooting and root cause analysis methodologies •Ability to manage multiple incidents, priorities, and stakeholders concurrently •Experience documenting incidents, actions, and outcomes in structured systems Preferred skills and experience •ITIL Foundation certification v3 or v4 or higher •Experience supporting large scale or enterprise customer environments •Experience facilitating post incident reviews and driving corrective actions •Comfort working with ambiguity while maintaining structured decision making •Experience managing executive or senior stakeholder expectations during critical incidents  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
CallHippo is looking for a proactive, relationship and growth number driven **Customer Success Manager** to own and grow a portfolio of 60 to 70 accounts spanning SMB and Mid-Market/Enterprise customers. You'll be the primary point of contact for your customers - driving adoption, retention, and expansion, while working closely with the Head of Customer Success to convert every customer conversation into a concrete growth action.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Account Management & Relationship Building**

* Own end-to-end relationship management for 60 to 70 assigned accounts (SMB and Mid-Market/Enterprise mix).
* Build strong, trust-based relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers within each account.
* Conduct regular check-ins, onboarding calls, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to understand customer goals and usage.
* Document every customer call as a clear MOM (Minutes of Meeting) with action items, owners, and timelines.
* Proactively follow up on MOM action items to ensure customer needs are addressed and value is delivered.

### **Retention**

* Own the **retention/renewal outcome** for your book of accounts — track usage, engagement, and health scores to flag at-risk customers early.
* Build and execute save plans for at-risk accounts in collaboration with your Head of Customer Success.
* Drive product adoption and feature utilization to increase stickiness and reduce churn risk.

### **Cross-Sell & Upsell**

* Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities within your portfolio based on customer usage patterns and business needs.
* Position relevant CallHippo features/plans/add-ons that solve customer pain points and add value.
* Work with Sales/Account Executives to convert expansion opportunities into closed revenue.
* Track and report on pipeline of upsell/cross-sell opportunities within your accounts. Targets of cross sell/ upsell must be accomplished and number driven mindset is non negotiable.

### **Collaboration & Reporting**

* Escalate product issues or feedback to Support/Product teams and follow through to resolution.
* Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in the CRM/CS platform (account notes, health scores, MOMs, opportunities).
* Share customer insights and trends with the Head of Customer Success to inform team-wide strategy.
* Participate in team reviews, pipeline discussions, and coaching sessions.

**Required Skills & Experience**
--------------------------------

* **2–5 years** of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a client-facing role, ideally in SaaS/B2B tech.
* Demonstrated ability to manage a **high-volume portfolio** (60+ accounts) without losing personal touch.
* Strong **relationship-building** skills — comfortable engaging with stakeholders from SMB founders to Enterprise decision-makers.
* Experience or aptitude in **cross-sell/upselling** — able to spot opportunities and have value-based conversations. Number driven mindset and targets (OKRs) are non-negotiable.
* Excellent **organizational skills** — able to track and follow through on MOM action items across a large account base consistently.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal; comfortable running calls, QBRs, and email follow-ups.
* Familiarity with CRM/CS tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, Gainsight, Freshsuccess, or similar).
* Data-driven mindset — comfortable using account health metrics and usage data to prioritize outreach.
* Experience in telephony/VoIP or SaaS products is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like (First 3 Months)**
--------------------------------------------

* Fully ramped on assigned portfolio with strong relationships established across key accounts.
* Consistent MOM documentation and action-item follow-through for every customer interaction.
* Healthy retention rate within your book of accounts, with early identification and resolution of at-risk customers.
* Active, tracked pipeline of cross-sell/upsell opportunities with measurable conversions.
* Recognized by customers and internal stakeholders as a trusted, reliable point of contact.

**Why Join CallHippo**
----------------------

* Own a meaningful, high-trust relationship with a diverse set of customers from SMB to Enterprise.
* Clear growth path into senior CSM or Customer Success leadership roles.
* Collaborative, fast-paced environment with direct visibility into company revenue impact.

title: Customer Success Executive / Specialist (Saleshandy)
description:
**About Saleshandy**
--------------------

Saleshandy helps sales teams, agencies and founders run cold email outreach that actually lands in the inbox. More than 4,000 customers use us every day to find leads, send sequences and book meetings.

**About the role**
------------------

Support and success are one team at Saleshandy now. The same person answers a customer on chat, onboards them, and owns the account after that. You'll handle live chat and email, and you'll also look after your own set of accounts. That means onboarding new customers quickly, spotting who might churn before they leave, and finding the ones who could grow with us.

We're hiring 3 people for this team. You'll report to the Customer Success Team Lead and have a 1:1 with them every week.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Support on chat and email**

* Keep your first response time (FRT) under 15 minutes and reply within 5 to 10 minutes after that
* Keep CSAT at 100%. When a customer leaves a bad rating, review the case and work out what went wrong
* Own escalations and close them within the promised time
* Troubleshoot deliverability issues: why emails land in spam, domain and inbox setup, warm-up
* Handle refund requests. Understand the real problem first and try to fix it before processing the refund
* Pass bugs and product gaps to the Product team with clear examples

### **Owning your accounts**

* Onboard every new account within 24 to 48 hours, whether it came from Sales or signed up on its own
* Run a 30-60-90 day plan for each new account so they reach value early
* Hold regular check-ins with your accounts and catch churn signals early
* Every week, share your high-risk accounts with the reason each one is at risk, and your high-potential accounts with why each one could grow
* Follow up on voluntary churn, paused accounts, failed payments and overdue renewals. Find out why they left and try to bring them back
* When a high-potential account churns, do an RCA so the same thing doesn't happen again

**You'll fit well if you**
--------------------------

* Have 1 to 3 years in customer support, customer success or account management, ideally at a SaaS company. We'll consider freshers who show real ownership
* Write clearly and fast. Most of this job happens over chat and email
* Follow up without being chased and document what you do
* Want to understand why a customer is unhappy before you reply
* Know cold email, outbound tools or email deliverability (a big plus)
* Have used Intercom or a similar support tool
* Are flexible to work day or night shifts. We support customers round the clock across the Americas, EMEA and APAC

**What we offer**
-----------------

* A learning budget for courses, books and events
* Health insurance allowance
* Annual team retreat
* Room to grow into Senior CS, Team Lead or Customer Success Ops
